e357bc3a1b31b214.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative to join their team in Taif. This full-time role focuses on implementing the showroom sales plan and achieving assigned sales targets while ensuring a high standard of customer service. Key Responsibilities Welcome customers, provide comprehensive product information, and assist with color coordination and product selection. Process orders, manage invoicing, and coordinate product delivery efficiently. Handle product handovers and provide pre-sales and after-sales customer support. Supervise showroom operations and inventory, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Coordinate showroom personnel activities, including assistants, laborers, and drivers, to maintain efficient operations. Maintain showroom cleanliness, organization, and overall presentation. Ensure the availability of marketing materials such as brochures, leaflets, and product catalogs. Achieve assigned sales targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in line with the approved sales plan. Process customer orders via online channels and update the e-commerce platform, reflecting accurate product and inventory levels. Ensure adequate stock availability, particularly for fast-moving items, and apply stock replenishment procedures from warehouses based on established minimum and maximum levels. Comply with the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle to minimize slow-moving and obsolete inventory. Report any missing or unavailable products at the central warehouse to the direct manager. Report damage, equipment malfunctions, or maintenance requirements within the showroom and follow up on corrective actions. Conduct inventory counts, reconcile physical balances, and report any shortages, damage, or loss. Complete the daily closing process accurately and on time, including proper handling and recording of customer advance payments. Execute assigned marketing programs and initiatives, including product campaigns and field visits to residential development areas. Ensure all showroom employees comply with approved uniform and dress code requirements. Promote and sell all company product ranges to achieve sales targets and maximize opportunities. Ensure the availability and proper condition of safety equipment, including valid Civil Defense and municipal licenses, fire extinguishers, and roadworthiness of company vehicles. Ensure implementation and compliance with the company's Ashanak program terms and conditions. Comply with company policies, procedures, and established guidelines. Execute activities related to the function using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform any other duties assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Taif, focusing on showroom operations and direct customer engagement. Application Process Candidates interested in this Showroom Sales Representative role are encouraged to apply.

e37e4e82bba4a93b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيات صناعه البلاستيك عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم دورة حياة المنتج وأسعار المنافسين. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب الخاصة باختبارات السوق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

e3cea825fe431713.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة ركن العماد للمقاولات العامة عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى تحديث بيانات الموظفين والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة بشكل فعال عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية. القدرة على التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة ركن العماد للمقاولات العامة في مدينة بريدة، القصيم. ستعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالأنظمة والإجراءات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

e35918758c06a8af.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Housekeeping Manager to join their team in Taif, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Ensure all guest rooms, suites, public areas, and back-of-house spaces meet the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, and quality, in line with IHG brand standards. Collaborate with the Front Office and other operational departments to anticipate guest needs, accommodate special requests, and provide personalized attention for VIPs and returning guests. Conduct regular inspections and quality assessments, identify areas for improvement, and implement procedures to safeguard hotel standards and enhance the guest experience. Develop and implement leasing strategies to enhance occupancy and revenue. Identify new business opportunities and contribute to company growth. e3910bb5c61fe182.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA designs transport solutions and partners with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems. The Group operates in over 80 countries, supporting clients in digital, ecological, and energy transitions for future mobility. Review architectural designs, drawings, specifications, reports, and material submissions for compliance with project requirements and standards. Oversee architectural coordination with structural, civil, MEP, urban design, and specialist systems teams. Monitor design development and construction progress for architectural works across stations and associated assets. Review contractor and consultant submissions, including shop drawings, method statements, mock-ups, and material samples. Identify design issues, coordination clashes, technical risks, and constructability concerns, and support their resolution. Participate in design review workshops, technical meetings, and stakeholder coordination sessions. Conduct site inspections and monitor architectural works to ensure compliance with approved designs, specifications, quality, and timelines. Demonstrated experience within complex transportation environments, particularly metro projects. Strong technical and design-focused architectural background. e3179e490e99555c.description: عن العمل: مطلوب مسوقين وممثلي مبيعات ميدانيين يمتلكون علاقات قوية مع أصحاب المعارض والمتاجر (سيارات، ساعات، أنتيك، فاخرات، أجهزة) لاستقطابهم وتوثيق حساباتهم كـ "تجار موثقين" في تطبيق مزادات حي وبث مباشر. المهام: زيارة المعارض والمتاجر ميدانياً وتوضيح ميزات البث والمزايدات المباشرة. إقناع التاجر بالتسجيل، توثيق الحساب، ومساعدته في إطلاق أول بث ومزاد حقيقي. المميزات ونظام الدفع: عمولات مجزية وفورية عن كل تاجر موثق يطلق بثه ومزاده الأول بنجاح. مكافآت إضافية عند تحقيق مستهدفات شهرية (Bonus).

e32bec1eea7853e9.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Senior Specialist Cost Accounting to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for supporting product costing, inventory valuation, and manufacturing finance activities. The position involves cost analysis, inventory accounting, variance reporting, and financial reporting processes to ensure accurate cost information and compliance with accounting standards. Role Purpose and Contribution The Senior Specialist Cost Accounting contributes to accurate cost information, inventory valuation, and operational decision-making. This role ensures adherence to accounting standards and company policies, playing a key part in the financial integrity of manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities Maintain product cost structures, Bills of Materials (BOMs), routings, and standard costing information within approved systems and processes. Perform product costing activities, cost roll-ups, and standard cost updates to support accurate costing and inventory valuation. Analyze direct material, labor, and manufacturing overhead costs, and support cost estimate development for products and manufacturing activities. Conduct manufacturing variance analysis, including material, labor, overhead, and inventory variances, and investigate significant deviations. Support inventory valuation activities, inventory reconciliations, inventory provision assessments, and cycle count reviews. Monitor inventory movements, write-offs, slow-moving inventory, and obsolete inventory, providing analysis and recommendations as required. Support month-end and year-end closing activities through the preparation of reconciliations, journal entries, schedules, and costing analyses. Prepare cost, inventory, margin, and profitability reports to support operational and financial performance reviews. Ensure compliance with IFRS, company accounting policies, and internal controls related to costing and inventory accounting. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Finance teams to support costing activities, process improvements, and business initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in cost accounting or a related financial role. A strong understanding of accounting standards and manufacturing finance processes is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring collaboration with various internal departments including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, and Finance teams. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role to contribute to CEER's financial operations.

e3f1700eef131ddd.description: About ABB and the Role ABB is seeking an OT Security Analyst for its Electrification (EL) division. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role supports ABB Electrification's global OT security operations across worldwide factories and operational sites, contributing to the Regional Security – AMEA / Head of Information Security & Compliance – EL. Role Purpose and Context The OT Security Analyst acts as a coordinator and facilitator, bridging global OT security services, country-level Information Security (IS) teams, and factory operations. The primary objective is to ensure cohesive and consistent OT security management. This involves responsibility for OT device onboarding, vulnerability management, asset visibility, compliance support, and stakeholder reporting, all in alignment with ABB IS policies, standards, and global OT security frameworks. Key Responsibilities Facilitate and support the onboarding of OT devices onto Intrusion Detection System (IDS) platforms, including Nozomi and Claroty, across global factory sites. Configure and maintain OT security modules within ServiceNow (SNOW) for asset and incident management. Generate and analyze vulnerability reports from IDS platforms, contextualizing findings for specific factory OT environments. Coordinate remediation efforts with factory and country IS teams, monitor progress, validate fix effectiveness, and track remediation status. Maintain accurate and comprehensive OT asset inventories across IDS platforms and ServiceNow, ensuring full asset visibility. Support periodic OT security assessments, compliance checks, and audit activities to ensure adherence to ABB IS policies and OT security standards (ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF). Provide weekly status updates on onboarding progress, vulnerability management activities, and key risks to relevant stakeholders. Act as the primary liaison between global OT security services, country IS teams, and factory operations. Set up and improve local engagement processes to coordinate with global OT security services and meet compliance goals. Ensure all activities comply with ABB Regulations, ABB Group IS Guidelines, and applicable security policies, maintaining audit readiness. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in OT security or a related field. Demonstrated experience with IDS platforms such as Nozomi and Claroty. Familiarity with ServiceNow for asset and incident management. Knowledge of OT security standards including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST CSF. Experience in vulnerability management and remediation coordination. Ability to coordinate with diverse teams across different geographies. About ABB Electrification ABB Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions, and services. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers. The division partners with customers to advance power delivery and security, improve energy management, raise efficiency, and support reliable operations towards a low-carbon society. Application Information Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Further information about ABB and its global impact can be found at *********

e32769f6909e7b6b.description: About FieldCore and GE Vernova FieldCore, part of GE Vernova’s Gas Power One Field Services team, specializes in the installation, maintenance, and upgrades of power generation equipment. This work enables operators of global energy infrastructure to provide reliable and affordable energy. GE Vernova is a global energy company focused on Power, Wind, and Electrification businesses, committed to leading the energy transition by electrifying and decarbonizing the world. The company helps customers power economies and deliver vital electricity, with over 80,000 employees across 100+ countries. Role Overview: Rigger The Rigger role at FieldCore involves specialized tasks related to moving and lifting exceptionally heavy objects, often in challenging environments where standard material handling equipment cannot be used. Riggers utilize equipment specifically designed for handling loads weighing hundreds of thousands or millions of pounds/kilograms. This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia and requires a trainee level of experience (0-1 years), serving as a trial to assess suitability for the company in terms of attitude, skills, and ambition. Key Responsibilities Signal or verbally direct workers involved in hoisting and moving loads to ensure safety. Perform assignments, as directed by the crew chief or field supervisor, for the installation and maintenance of power plants, facilities, and oilfield pumping units. Test rigging to ensure safety and reliability before operations. Attach loads to rigging using hand and power tools, preparing them for movement. Select appropriate gear, including slings, shackles, chokers, and winches, based on load specifications and work schedules. Control the movement of heavy equipment through confined spaces using specialized tools like chain falls and gin poles. Manipulate rigging lines, hoists, and pulling gear to maneuver or support materials. Clean and dress machine surfaces and component parts. Attach pulleys and blocks to overhead structures using bolts and clamps. Dismantle and store rigging equipment properly after use. Ensure safety in all aspects of work, including compliance with JSAs, attendance at safety meetings, and participation in equipment audits. Assist in safety and environmental incident investigations and comply with STOP Observations and Near Miss Programs. Travel extensively, both internationally and domestically, and be available to work holidays, weekends, and overtime as required by field assignments. Required Qualifications High School Diploma combined with related mechanical experience (*, carpentry, lifts, cranes). Basic skills training demonstrating knowledge of fundamental concepts, practices, and procedures in a specialized field. A Level I Rigging Certificate is mandatory. Desired Characteristics Experience with power generation equipment, including gas/steam turbines and associated auxiliary components. Proficiency in applying correct rigging tackle for specified loads and identifying specific shackles and beam clamps. Knowledge of color codes for lifting slings or wires (belt slings, endless bag slings, wire strops). Understanding and ability to act upon basic safe systems of work and method statements, including approved rigging studies. Familiarity with Safety Mandatory Emergency Stop Signals. Working knowledge of various heavy equipment operations, such as Forklift, Tele Handler, Scissor Lift, Cherry Picker, Tractor (Tractor Cottil with lifting Arm), and Overhead Cranes (pendant, cab, or remotely operated). Work Environment This role involves working in diverse and sometimes adverse weather conditions, including high and low temperatures and windy environments. The position requires significant travel and flexibility to work outside standard hours as dictated by field assignments.

e397a936e5eb7c8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ركن الكسائي الطبي عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وإعداد التقارير المحاسبية بدقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة، مع القدرة على مواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ركن الكسائي الطبي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مجال المحاسبة.

e3cdd2013f2e0abd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي لغوي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية مراجعة وتدقيق وتصحيح الكتب والمنشورات لضمان جودتها اللغوية وتوافقها مع ثقافة القراء، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم المحتوى وتنسيقه بشكل احترافي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتدقيق وتصحيح الكتب والمنشورات والنصوص من الناحية اللغوية، بما في ذلك القواعد وعلامات الترقيم، وتوزيع الفقرات، وتنسيق الجمل، وطريقة العرض والكتابة. التأكد من توافق طريقة الكتابة وعرض المحتوى مع ثقافة القراء والمنهج المتعارف عليه في الكتابة. مراجعة وترتيب المحتوى والتأكد من تنظيمه بشكل متناسق من حيث المحاذاة وطول النص وغيرها من المؤثرات التي تعكس شكل النص. اختيار عدد الصفحات والألوان والخطوط والصور والمؤثرات الأخرى التي تعكس طبيعة المحتوى، وترتيب الفقرات والمقالات في المنشورات، وتقديم التوصيات بأفضل الوسائل لعرضها. تلخيص الفقرات أو إعادة صياغتها وربطها ببعض، والتأكد من احتوائها على الكلمات التي تعبر عن الفكرة المراد إيصالها للقارئ. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. إتقان اللغة العربية وقواعدها النحوية والإملائية وعلامات الترقيم. القدرة على مراجعة وتصحيح النصوص بدقة عالية. فهم عميق لثقافة القراء وكيفية عرض المحتوى بما يتناسب معهم. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تدقيق لغوي ممتازة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. القدرة على تنظيم وترتيب المحتوى بشكل متناسق. مهارات تواصل جيدة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

e3e9e1520a8698af.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات عن مهندس مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ الأعمال المساحية المكتبية والميدانية لمشاريع متنوعة، مع ضمان الدقة والمطابقة للمواصفات الفنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتضمن هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام المساحية المتخصصة، بدءًا من الدراسات الأولية وصولاً إلى إعداد التقارير الفنية. تشمل المسؤوليات ما يلي: القيام بالأعمال المساحية الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية، بالإضافة إلى مهام الاستشعار عن بعد والمسح البحري. تنفيذ جميع أعمال المسح اللازمة لمشاريع الأبنية والطرق وغيرها من المشاريع الإنشائية. رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية بدقة عالية. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال المساحية في الموقع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير المحددة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال المساحية وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. إجراء الدراسات الاستطلاعية وإعداد شبكات المساحة المثلثية. الإشراف على تثبيت نقاط الاستناد المرجعية للمشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة المساحة. القدرة على العمل في كل من البيئات المكتبية والميدانية. إتقان استخدام الأدوات والبرامج المساحية المتخصصة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام العمل الموكلة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة المبرز، ضمن المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم.

e3f6f0f2dc257c74.description: Our Vision, we make moments M venpick Hotels & Residences (MH&R) is in the moments business. We re intimately involved in important times in our guests lives. And you never know when a moment can be made. A simple smile in the lobby can create the positivity that turns a business trip into a new business celebration. An insider tip on the best way to spend a day can make an entire holiday. A romantic dinner for two can lead to a longer-term partnership. It doesn t take much to create a moment just be genuine, human, and warm. Take small steps to turn the ordinary into something extraordinary We understand that this vision cannot be achieved without great people who create and support work environments designed to produce exceptional results. The Role 1. To oversee and lead the Banquet department of the Hotel. 2. Banquet Manager is responsible for the smooth operation of his/her specific Event as governed by contract and deemed by operational requirements. 3. He or she must be fully responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of banquet FF&E and OSE, as well as for organizing storage areas and ensuring cleanliness. 4. He/she is responsible in linking all facets of cuisine and entertainment and then delivering these to guests. 5. He/she must be able to control and coordinate a labour pool of many and varied backgrounds. 6. He/she will have a majority of casual labour and hence it is essential to have quality staff management skills. 7. Should be creative and confident and be prepared to step outside of the confines of comfort. 8. He/she should take the time to get to know the guests and be committed to service excellence. 9. Team play is imperative and having the time to invest in self-development is mandatory. 10. Being entrepreneurial, thinking beyond the boundaries and leading by example are expected and not requested. Key Deliverables and Responsibilities Planning & Organizing: 1. Ensure that all M venpick Hotels & Residences standards are adhered. 2. He/she must check the daily casual staff's grooming standards and verify their Ajeer permits and iqamas on a daily basis without fail (if the Ajeer permits and iqamas are not available, the concerned casual staff must be sent back to the company immediately without fail). 3. Be innovative at all the time. 4. Keep ahead of industry trends (you should set the trends rather than follow) 5. Develop ideas on increasing guest satisfaction. 6. The role is to uphold the Movenpick service standard and manage daily in-house and ODC events. Operations: 1. Leads the daily and weekly meeting. 2. Train and develop the Banquet team in the departmental operating standards. 3. Maintains a presence during events including outside catering events. 4. Maintain a consistent focus on improving the overall flow of Banquet operations. 5. To lead and support employees in the achievement of financial, operational and service delivery targets via effective organizational policy and procedural development and appropriate employee training activities. 6. Foster a winning, solution-oriented work environment, motivating and engaging employees to continuously deliver the best possible service and to provide feedback and suggestions. 7. Source and audition entertainment and decorative options suitable for Banquets and Events. 8. Maintain awareness of industry trends and share with the team. 9. Review, analyse market and competition changes and implement proactive action plans to meet these changes in cooperation with Banquet manager and approved by Director of F&B. 10. Ensure organizers are communicated with and assisted in an efficient, warm and professional manner by all team members. 11. Actively review organizer and guest comments and feedback, communicate this with the team members and implement procedures to enhance guest satisfaction 12. To ensure a consistently high standard of grooming is followed and the team. 13. To have a complete understanding of and to adhere to M venpick Hotels & Residences policy relating to Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety. 14. To drive the performance of the Banquet team members, including completion of performance appraisals, coaching counselling and performance management in conjunction with Human Resources. 15. Have full knowledge of all products and services provided by the property and in the local area. 16. Assume the responsibility of daily banquet operations. 17. Maintain appropriate staffing levels on the banquet floor. 18. Following up on opening and closing checklists on daily basis. 19. Ensure all appropriate equipment is on hand for each service period. 20. Ensure all the storages are well maintain and organize. 21. Ensures that the correct ordering and billing procedures are in place and that all cash handling is carried out correctly. This includes overseeing and checking the cashier and floats at the conclusion of the event and all banking done (specially banquet event order must be carefully monitored prier closing the bills) 22. All the banquet event orders (BEO) must be clearly studied and communicate with entire banquet team and concern departments. 23. Conducts daily briefings and training for all staff prior to commencement of shift, providing such information as service requirements, sequence and preparation for the day 24. Must be capable of handling security incidents, guest complaints or queries with confidence and in a professional manner. 25. Directly work with F&B director and all banquet employees to create a flow of new and improved ideas. 26. Ensure awareness and deliver the optimum levels of service and guest satisfaction 27. Attaining and maintaining the sanitation (HACCP or similar) certificates as required by the regional governing body. 28. Ensure all hotel property and facilities are maintained an in an optimal working order. 29. Take full ownership and responsibility for any issues that may occur in the department. 30. Ensure rooms/events is set prior to the commencement of service. 31. Master all POS systems 32. To carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned. Administration: 1. Establish and maintain effective employee relationships. 2. Implement training plans to further develop self and subordinate outlet employees. 3. Lead by example through a passionate, hands on approach. 4. Maintaining all outlet records. 5. Maintain and submit the month-end banquet operations report, including casual and permanent attendance, AV rental details. 6. Evaluate an employee s performance in staff appraisals, with a focus on adherence to procedures and departmental standards.

e3edc892f6823d87.description: About the Role Ma’aden is seeking a Manager, Operational Technology Infra-Structure, Hosting & Connectivity to lead the operational technology (OT) infrastructure, hosting, and connectivity environments. Execute routine maintenance, patching, upgrades, backups, lifecycle management, and infrastructure health monitoring activities. Implement OT infrastructure, hosting, connectivity, and edge platform standards across sites and operational environments. Maintaining clear operating procedures, service dashboards, risk logs, and stakeholder communications for OT infrastructure services is also essential. Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain OT compute, storage, virtualization, and network environments. Experience with lifecycle management, modernization, and operational resilience practices for industrial systems.

e30979e2bbf70253.description: At Salla, we are building the digital backbone of commerce in the region, empowering thousands of merchants to start, grow, and scale their businesses. We turn what's complex into something simple, powerful, and scalable. Every Salla store runs on one storefront. When a buyer searches, opens a product, or reads a review, they decide whether to trust a store they may have never heard of. Every change you ship reaches thousands of stores at once. We are looking for a Product Manager who builds with curiosity, clarity, and care. You own search, the product page, and reviews: how buyers find what they want, decide, and trust what they read. You work side by side with our data and AI teams and turn their models into decisions buyers feel and merchants see in their sales. Core Responsibilities: Know Salla's buyers: how they shop across very different stores, and what makes them hesitate, compare, or leave. Bring their voice into every decision, along with the merchants whose sales depend on it. Own search, the product page, and reviews end to end, from discovery to iteration, tied to buyer conversion and merchant sales. Partner with data and AI teams on ranking, query understanding, and semantic search. Decide what ships, to which stores, and how you measure it. Design the product page around the buyer's decision: what they need to see, trust, and confirm before they buy. Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews. Experiment by default and Ship safely across thousands of stores: staged rollouts, experiments, guardrails, and a way back. Run continuous discovery: talk to buyers and merchants regularly, watch real sessions, and test ideas with prototypes before committing engineering time. Make decisions with data: define the metrics that matter for each surface, read the funnel yourself, and let evidence, not opinion, settle debates. 4–6 years of experience in Product Management , preferably owning Search, Discovery, Product Pages, Conversion, or other customer-facing product experiences within a live consumer or e-commerce product. Proven experience driving product metrics and business outcomes , with the ability to explain what changed, why it changed, and how the impact was measured. AI-native mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools for data analysis, prototyping, research and interpreting product results. Experience working closely with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on Search, Ranking, or Recommendation with a clear understanding of product ownership and decision-making responsibilities. Hands-on experience conducting User Research and Product Experiments, using insights to influence product decisions. Strong understanding of Arabic Search and Discovery , including Arabic spelling variations, dialects, transliteration, Arabic-English mixed queries, and search behavior. Demonstrated ownership of product outcomes , with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment. You simplify: you cut before you add. Fluent in Arabic and English , both written and spoken. Preferred: Experience building a product, feature, or business from 0-to-1 , either as a founder, early-stage team member, or founding product team member.
